capabilities: Render the vault as an interactive 3D force-directed graph
Group and color nodes by folder or tag with cohesion and separation forces
Focus a local graph on the active note up to N hops
Open notes by clicking graph nodes, with hover titles and orbit/zoom controls
Run force simulation in a Web Worker with a WebAssembly physics core
extras: Desktop only. Includes benchmark tables measured on Apple Silicon and a build-from-source guide; not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author wanted to show a huge number of notes beautifully in 3D while keeping the view smooth, filling the gap where the built-in graph struggles on large vaults.
problem: The built-in graph view slows down and becomes hard to use on very large vaults.
summary: 3D force-directed graph view that renders the whole vault with GPU instancing and Web Worker physics, staying smooth at 50,000+ nodes.
